author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Pollution mask: outer shape with a half-ellipse top, straight sides and a flatter half-ellipse bottom, as in the reference (was an upright egg). The upper edge rises to a pointed nose-bridge peak left of centre and slopes gently right; the lower edge is a shallow arch. Deliberately asymmetric like the reference. No Lucide match; ellipse arcs + cubics.
omissions: The lower arch is shallower than the reference's so it stays 9 clear of the upper edge; its ends sit on the straight sides rather than on the bottom arc.
